title: Not Great
text: Not Great. These bags aren’t the best. First, the straps are much too long. Portions just don’t work. Next, they free on the inside with use. They aren’t very heavy duty either. I use these for crafting, but I’m kind of sad that I put so much work into them because they did not hold up very well.
